workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.description: Multi-account GitHub access and repository browsing

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: Desktop configuration and debugging entry points

shell.title: HagiCode Hub
shell.description: A desktop shell for the next phase of Hagihub development, with UI primitives, state management, and Electron bridge wiring already in place.
shell.navigationDescription: Move between foundation, repository workflow, and future settings surfaces without leaving the same desktop shell.
shell.prepareTitle: Prepare Hagihub for the next phase of application development.
shell.prepareDescription: The renderer is no longer a single demo page. It now behaves as an application shell with reusable UI, centralized state, theme tokens, and Electron data access.
shell.rendererStackDescription: Core state, component, and build foundations are now connected, so feature work can continue on top of them directly.
shell.environmentSnapshotDescription: Injected through the preload API and managed centrally by Redux.
foundationModules: React 19 renderer entry with strict TypeScript setup
Redux Toolkit store with typed hooks and async preload bridge state
shadcn-compatible component registry and Tailwind foundation
Renderer aliasing with @/ imports for scalable module growth

overview.title: Foundation ready
overview.detail: Dependencies, folder layout, and state management have moved beyond a single page demo and into an extensible app shell.

overview.title: Electron bridge online
overview.detail: App info from the main process is now fetched through a Redux thunk.

overview.title: UI system ready
overview.detail: New pages can build directly on top of shadcn-style components and shared design tokens.

workspace.title: Hub dashboard
workspace.detail: Instance lists, resource monitoring, task panels, and inbox modules can land here next.

workspace.title: Feature modules
workspace.detail: A dedicated features directory is the next clean split for slices, components, and IPC contracts.

workspace.title: Navigation growth
workspace.detail: The current section state already leaves room for tabs or router-based navigation later.

settings.title: Environment controls
settings.detail: Log levels, update channels, experimental flags, and diagnostics can be added here later.

settings.title: State persistence
settings.detail: If local configuration persistence is needed, it can be added in middleware or through preload IPC.

settings.title: Design system scale
settings.detail: Future forms, dialogs, and tables should continue extending the same shadcn component directory.

nextSteps: Split future components, slices, and IPC actions under src/renderer/features by domain.
Keep extending components.json when more shadcn components are needed.
Switch from section state to React Router once the app grows beyond a single shell view.
